name: Hostfully
description: Bookings, the channels, and the owner accounting for a short-term rental manager, plus a digital guidebook for the guest, with extras to sell. United States.

mentions.evidence: VentureScout says $5.5 million of revenue in 2023, growing 68 percent year over year. The about page says 40,000 clients implemented. A GetLatka page that had been used for a higher estimate now returns not found, so that number is not in this note.
mentions.indieAngle: A phone page with the Wi-Fi, the check-in steps, and a few local tips. Sold to people who host.

whyItPrints: The back office for someone running other people's holiday lets. The guidebook is the cheap way in.
whyThisMatters: Someone running other people's holiday lets needs the booking, the listing sites, and a statement for the owner. Hostfully is that back office, and it also sells a digital guidebook the guest opens on a phone, with the Wi-Fi, the check-in, and a few things to buy. United States. VentureScout puts 2023 revenue at five point five million, up sixty-eight percent on the year before. The about page says forty thousand clients implemented. I am not sure that count and the revenue line are the same kind of number, so they stay side by side. A GetLatka page that an earlier pass had used for a higher estimate now comes back as not found. I am not writing that higher figure down without the page. The guidebook on its own, a single mobile page for a host, is the small version of the same business. The Wi-Fi, the door code, and a local tip are enough of a product to charge for before anyone touches the owner statement.
